title: The Best Easy Way to Capture Analog Video (it's a little weird)
summary: Technology Connections shows a cheap method for capturing analog video: a composite-to-HDMI upscaler feeding an HDMI capture dongle, aimed at digitizing home movies and VHS tapes.
why: HN people recommend it as an affordable, good-quality way to digitize analog video.

quote.text: does some good coverage of capturing/converting analogue video - hardware choices make huge difference.
